description: This PHP source file defines the EntityTypeInfo class for handling workspace-related hooks in Drupal, including entity type build, alter, field info, and base field info modifications.

classes.name: EntityTypeInfo
classes.description: Handles hooks related to entity type information and workspace support in Drupal.

methods.name: entityTypeBuild
methods.description: Adds workspace support handlers to entity types based on their properties.

methods.name: entityTypeAlter
methods.description: Adds workspace configuration and constraints to entity types supported by workspace.

methods.name: fieldInfoAlter
methods.description: Modifies field definitions, e.g., constraints on entity references and path aliases.

methods.name: entityBaseFieldInfo
methods.description: Defines base fields for entity types, such as the workspace reference.
